# Task — Issue 1103: Quick Search results footer regained the "Generated by TestLink on …" stamp

The modern **Quick Search** screen (`gui/templates/search/searchQuickView.html`)
closed its results with the match count only (`#footerInfo`, e.g. "5 matches").
The legacy results page closed the block with a
**"Generated by TestLink on `<date>`"** stamp below the results — the stamp is
back, rendered server-side in the TestLink session-locale format.

## Legacy behaviour (1.9.20)

`gui/templates/dashio/testcases/tcSearchResults.tpl:33-39`

```smarty
{if $gui->doSearch}
  <div class="workBack">
  {if !isset($gui->warning_msg) || $gui->warning_msg == ''}
    {foreach from=$gui->tableSet key=idx item=matrix}
      {$tableID="table_$idx"}
      {$matrix->renderBodySection($tableID)}
    {/foreach}
    <br />
    {lang_get s='generated_by_TestLink_on'} {$smarty.now|date_format:$gsmarty_timestamp_format}
  {else}
    <div class="user_feedback"><br />{$gui->warning_msg}</div>
  {/if}
```

* `generated_by_TestLink_on` = "Generated by TestLink on" + the render time,
  formatted by Smarty with `$gsmarty_timestamp_format`, which
  `lib/functions/tlsmarty.inc.php:304` assigns from
  `$tlCfg->locales_timestamp_format[$session locale]` (`cfg/const.inc.php:303`) —
  i.e. the **logged-in user's language** format, including the **time** component
  (e.g. `%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S`), unlike the date-only `date_format`.
* The stamp sits inside the `no warning` guard, so a `no_records_found`,
  `testcase_does_not_exists`, `empty_testproject` or `too_wide_search_criteria`
  search shows the feedback box and **no** stamp.

## The gap (modern screen)

`searchQuickView.html` had only `#footerInfo` (`:249`), rewritten by
`renderResults()` with `TLi18n.t('search.matchCount', …)` (`:640`) — no
timestamp anywhere, no `#footerGenerated` element in the DOM.

Measured baseline (browser, fixture project `QSDemo` id=1, quick text `queen`,
5 matches):

```
footers            : ["footerInfo:5 matches", ":TestLink 2.0.1 - Quick Search"]
#footerGenerated   : ABSENT from DOM
/api/search?action=search&tproject_id=1&name=queen -> keys:
                     ["status","count","rows","warning","tcasePrefix","generated_on","generated_on_iso"]
generated_on       : "08/10/2026 13:37:19"   <- server already formats it; UI never renders it
rows: 5   warning: ""                        <- exactly the condition legacy stamps under
```

The BFF half of the gap was already closed for the twin screen `searchView.html`
in issue #1093 (commit `45b3ce4f0`) — `action=search` returns `generated_on`
(locale-aware `tlStrftime(timestamp_format, locales_timestamp_format[$locale])`)
and `generated_on_iso` — so **no API change was needed**; the gap was purely UI.

## Modern re-implementation (UI only)

`gui/templates/search/searchQuickView.html`, mirroring the #1093 reference in
`searchView.html`:

| Change | Location |
|---|---|
| CSS `#footerGenerated .genon { color: #888; }` | `:59` |
| Footer block `<div class="footer" id="footerGenerated" style="display:none"><span class="genon" id="footerGenOn"></span></div>` between `#footerInfo` and the static version footer | `:251-258` |
| `renderGeneratedFooter(r)` — shows the line only when rows exist AND `r.warning` is empty AND `r.generated_on` is present (exact legacy `{if !warning_msg}` condition); label `common.generatedBy` + server-formatted timestamp; `generated_on_iso` as tooltip title | `:525-543` |
| `renderResults()` calls it **before** the empty-early-return so no stale line survives a no-result re-search | `:550-552` |
| `resetForm()` hides the block and clears text/title | `:822-823` |

**i18n:** no new keys — `common.generatedBy` ("Generated by TestLink on" =
legacy `generated_by_TestLink_on`) exists in all 10 bundles; coverage gate
`bash ai/verify_i18n_coverage.sh` PASS (9/9). The issue text suggested
`common.generatedOn` ("Generated on"); `common.generatedBy` is the faithful
match for the legacy string, same choice as #1093.
